truthPolicy: frozen acceptance behavior; screenshots and run records are not created in Gate P2-0

cases.title: 桌面结构图
cases.inputs: viewport 1440x900 px; TRUSS-A01,FRAME-A01,CBEAM-A03; BEAM-A01 unit-conversion baseline
cases.steps: first load default t-mm-MPa-N-s; load BEAM-A01 default values; atomically switch SI and back; solve each structure and fit canvas; toggle node IDs,element IDs,local axes,supports,loads,results; read tables
cases.expected: unit selector visible/enabled/selected; all input/result/graphic/header/absolute-tolerance values convert; physical result/sign unchanged; canvas inside viewport; label overlap area=0 px^2; critical results unobscured; table values meet fixture truth; console errors=0; uncaught=0; scrollWidth-clientWidth=0 px
cases.tolerance: corresponding case tolerances; layout exact pixel assertions
cases.artifacts: suggest p2-ui-01-desktop.png; do not create this round

cases.title: 移动端结构图
cases.steps: first portrait load; verify default units and two visible unit options; enter BEAM-A01 default values, switch SI and back without loss; solve both; expand result table and scroll last column
cases.expected: touch targets >=44x44 px; page/graphic scrollWidth<=390 px; font>=12 px; labels do not obscure supports/loads/extrema; result table scrolls in own container or wraps cards without clipping units/signs; selector does not jump outside viewport; console errors=0; NaN/Infinity/-0 text count=0
cases.tolerance: corresponding case tolerances and exact pixel assertions
cases.artifacts: suggest p2-ui-02-mobile.png; do not create this round

cases.title: 离线单 HTML
cases.inputs: network off; clear network log; open delivery HTML by file://; BEAM-A01 default->SI->default; load BEAM-A01,TRUSS-A01,IL-A03; refresh and solve again
cases.expected: unit switching needs no network/backend; new background process count=0; external HTTP/HTTPS/WebSocket request count=0; three results equal fixtures; formulas,structure graphics,influence line visible; refresh restores default t-mm-MPa-N-s
cases.tolerance: corresponding case tolerances; request/process counts exact zero
cases.artifacts: record fixed browser/version,request count,three results during later acceptance; no server or record attachment this round

cases.title: 非法输入与奇异模型
cases.inputs: first solve BEAM-A01; then submit BEAM-N02 raw E=NaN, TRUSS-N01, FRAME-N01(b); after each error assertion reload and solve BEAM-A01; NaN must reach validation as nonfinite and not become empty/0
cases.expected: errors in order P2_NONFINITE_INPUT,P2_SINGULAR_STIFFNESS,P2_ZERO_LENGTH_ELEMENT with fields elements[0].E,constraints,elements[0].nodeJ; old result/legend/success state invalidated immediately; success text count=0 in error state; result table/graphic/legend NaN/Infinity/-0 count=0 (NaN echoed in error message excluded); uncaught console exception=0; each recovery recomputes BEAM-A01 truth and does not reuse old DOM
cases.tolerance: error code/field exact; recovered BEAM-A01 uses its fixture tolerance
cases.artifacts: later record code,field,stale-result assertion,text counts and each recovery value
